jamal: Acme follow-up: they want a one-page commitment for pilot SLAs and a clear dependency list. need reply today.
maria: i'll draft. quick inputs: runtime needs dedicated pool, infra needs reserved nodes + prewarm, security wants KMS or HSM timeline.
devon: technical: target p99 250ms is optimistic; give them staged targets: pilot p99 < 300ms with KMS, GA goal 250ms with quantized variant and HSM.
sasha: security: HSM timeline 3-4w for attestation. KMS pilot ok with signed risk waiver + limited data scope.
elena: infra: i'll scope capacity PR and include cost delta and autoscale limits. need devon to confirm prewarm node counts.
jamal: ok. maria draft: must-have vs nice-to-have, explicit rollback, measurement method, timeline for HSM.
maria: drafting now, will attach to thread. ops-bot: create runbook placeholder for circuit-breaker.
ops-bot: runbook "acme-pilot-circuit-breaker" created at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/1865432100
jamal: thanks. reconvene if any blocker. :thumbsup:
